data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Tanuj' holds profound spiritual significance for Hindus. 'Tanuja' is believed to be a name given by God, and is thus considered a divine blessing. The name is associated with Lord Shiva, one of the principal deities of Hinduism. Shiva, also known as Mahadeva or the supreme God, represents the divine masculine and is the god of destruction, transformation, and regeneration. By naming a child Tanuj, parents hope to invoke the blessings of Lord Shiva and bestow upon their child the virtues of strength, courage, and wisdom.
